data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 超市采购
data.description: 【樱岛麻衣 · 超市采购】傍晚的生鲜超市人流穿梭，戴着平光眼镜与针织帽的麻衣推着购物车，正认真比对着两盒新鲜的奶油炖菜食材。她侧过身轻轻戳了戳你的手臂——「今晚想吃奶油炖菜还是照烧鸡肉？提前说好，要是挑食的话，明天的便当就只有青椒了。」
data.action: 将购物车停在生鲜柜旁，双手各持一盒食材认真比较
data.promptProse: Mai compares two sealed ingredient trays, one in each hand, beside a stopped shopping cart at the fresh-food shelves. Plain glasses and a knit beanie complete her quiet disguise above a cardigan and long skirt. In the medium view, the cart handle sits alongside her rather than in her hands, and shelf tiers recede behind. Overhead supermarket lights brighten the tray lids and glasses, with gentle shadows under each shelf.
